title: Derive reviseArtifact's trace-field guard from the schemas
statement: Replace the hardcoded array of seventeen trace-like field names with a derivation over the schema set's `x-traceTarget` declarations, using the existing effective-schema resolver rather than re-reading schemas independently. Every declared trace field is then refused by construction, and adding one to a schema needs no code change.
notes: ⚠️ SECOND, NEVER FIRST. Closing this bypass before removal works would leave an invalid link unremovable by any typed path, with hand-editing forbidden by #88.
